scope: Six current-JS asynchronous action contracts. No renderer, timer-driven stallGuard or native async-equivalence claim.
limits: Only the listed authoritative fields are compared. Preview caches and the B.prog watchdog counter are excluded.
An abandoned shot may already have consumed RNG and usage telemetry; no rollback of those fields is asserted.
This does not cover GPU animation playback, native scene cancellation, every ability/Command or rejected animation promises.
